{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mardona III was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[September]] [[2023]] Game Update 7.3.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Confidence in Power">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230901-0|text=Galactic Season 5 "Confidence in Power"}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> [[Mardona III]] was originally introduced in the new [[canon]] continuity in the [[2015]] novel ''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'', written by [[Alexander Freed]].<ref name="Twilight Company">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''</ref>
